# R1/N14 — reverse signed-support phase diagram in the finite BRC-labelled two-law tree

2026-10-27. AUTHOR_EXACT_PROOF / UNREVIEWED / NOT_ADMITTED. External finite probability model; not native Heartbeat/X6 execution.

## Authority and input pins
GLOBAL_KNOWLEDGE_V1 main@cbb48b9ff8548098f731b527fee389662fbfe37a (bootstrap, manual, mathematics/BRC rules, ACTIVE worldview); Enterprise Math original research input main@de0c9b63b720128e63b79e56079779c3b2592d4d (P000 ACTIVE_LOCKED, joint-observer and X6/time rules, portable protocol). Reuses the exact model in research_notes/brc_n3_signed_support_global_phase_20261027_emr1/PROOF.md at that EM pin. Connected GitHub login awdawmip; native task inventory request r1-20261027-1504-tasks-read-11 returned CONTROL_QUOTA, so active owner and native CLAIM are unverified. This is independent author research, not a Driver review.

## Exact model
Let Q(h)>0 denote history mass and r(h)=P(h)/Q(h). Initial values (Q,r): root (1,1); a (1/2,3/2), b (1/2,1/2); ax (1/4,1), ay (1/4,2), bu (1/8,1), bv (3/8,1/3). At ax and bu, terminal ratios are (1/2,1,3/2), with conditional Q kernel K_s=(s,1-2s,s), using s_a and s_b respectively. At ay and bv, the one terminal child keeps its parent's ratio. Domain: 0<s_a,s_b<1/2. P=Qr on every history. All 15 prefixes and 8 leaves are strictly positive; each branch conserves Q and P because the Q-weighted successor ratio equals the parent ratio.

Full policies observe ordered history; compressed seedless policies observe only (time,r), with fresh local randomization and no persistent hidden seed. A policy stops/decides P or Q, or continues when a child exists. The only *nonterminal* collision is ax~bu, forcing a common action kernel. Observer: O=(P(decide Q),Q(decide P),E_P[T],E_Q[T]), where T starts at 0 at root. Signed objective J=68 O_1+84 O_2+7 O_3-3 O_4.

## Theorem — all real positive parameters in the domain
Write [x]_+=max(x,0), t=(9/2)s_a, u=(9/4)s_b. Minimum full-history and compressed objective values satisfy

    F = 251/4 - [t-1]_+ - [u-1/2]_+,
    C = min(251/4, 63 - [t-3/4]_+ - [u-1/2]_+),
    C-F = min([u-1/2]_+, [min(1/4,1-t)]_+).

Hence J strictly separates the full and seedless compressed *convex hulls* iff

    s_a < 2/9  AND  s_b > 2/9.

The global maximum gap is 1/4, attained exactly for s_a<=1/6 and s_b>=1/3 in the open square. At the rational point (s_a,s_b)=(1/6,1/3), F=125/2, C=251/4 and C-F=1/4. The previous normal (298,375,37,-17) had *zero* gap at this very point; the new normal closes that specific open case.

## Exact Bellman proof
Normalize continuation values by Q(h), excluding prior elapsed-time cost. At ratio r, a P decision costs 84; a Q decision costs 68r; continuing costs 7r-3 + sum_children(Q(child)/Q(h))*V(child). This uses P(h)=rQ(h), and both time observables gain one per surviving continuation.

At terminal ratios (1/2,1,3/2), the minimal decision values are (34,68,84). The singleton terminal ratios (2,1/3) cost (84,68/3). At the time-two nodes ay, bv, the optimal values are 84 and 22, respectively: ay continuation costs 95; bv continuation costs 22 <68/3. At ax/bu the full-history optimum is

    g(s)=min(84,68,4+34s+68(1-2s)+84s)=min(68,72-18s).

Since g(s)<=68, at a continuation has value A=(99+g(s_a))/2<=167/2<84, and at b continuation has value B=17+g(s_b)/4<=34. At root continuation costs 4+(A+B)/2<=251/4<68. Thus the full policy continues there, and

    F=149/4 + g(s_a)/4 + g(s_b)/8
     =251/4-[18s_a-4]_+/4-[18s_b-4]_+/8.

For a linear objective, fresh-randomized policies attain their infimum at a deterministic local action table: each time/ratio class is visited at most once per path, so the objective is separately affine in its action simplex; successive minimization over simplex vertices does not increase cost. Thus for compressed policies consider the three common actions at ax and bu:

* Common P: ax=bu=84, A=84, B=34, root=63.
* Common Q: ax=bu=68, A=167/2, B=34, root=251/4.
* Common continue: ax=72-18s_a, bu=72-18s_b, so
  A=84-[9s_a-3/2]_+, B=34-[(9/2)s_b-1]_+;
  root=63-[9s_a-3/2]_+/2-[(9/2)s_b-1]_+/2.

All three roots continue since the displayed values are <=63<68. The common-continue branch never exceeds 63, giving the formula for C.

Set X=[t-1]_+, U=[t-3/4]_+, Y=[u-1/2]_+. Then C-F=min(X+Y,1/4+X-U). For t<=3/4 it is min(Y,1/4); for 3/4<t<1 it is min(Y,1-t); for t>=1 it is zero. Therefore C-F=min(Y,[min(1/4,1-t)]_+), with the stated iff region and sharp global maximum. QED.

## Additional theorem: exact behavioral sufficiency on the diagonal
If s_a=s_b=s, the compressed (time,r) state is simultaneously strongly lumpable under Q and P. At ax/bu r=1 and conditional Q successor-ratio laws both equal K_s; their conditional P successor ratios are equal too, since P(child)/P(parent)=(r_child/r_parent)*Q(child)/Q(parent). Other nonterminal compressed fibers are singleton; common terminal ratios have no further transition.

For any full-history randomized stopping/decision policy, aggregate *surviving incoming Q mass* of histories in each state and Q-mass-weight their conditional action distributions into one common state action. Within each compressed fiber r is constant; hence the identical weights reproduce P action flows as well. Strong lumpability propagates aggregated state masses inductively under both laws. Thus the full terminal joint law of (T,(time,r),decision) is reproduced by a fresh-randomized compressed policy. Every compressed policy is a full policy, so the full and compressed **behavioral observation images are equal** on s_a=s_b, not only their convex hulls. This diagonal statement uses exactly the declared finite observation and policy language.

## Evidence, BRC status, limits and frontier
Companion VERIFY.py was executed with Python Fraction, testing P/Q conservation on all 15 prefixes, eight positive terminal masses, two exact Bellman minima plus the three common forced actions on 100 rational parameter pairs, boundary 2/9 and sharp example (1/6,1/3). RESULT.txt contains actual stdout. The real-parameter theorem and diagonal theorem are mathematical deductions above, not conclusions drawn from finite samples. BRC positive branch/path conservation and observer-fiber audit: REUSE_APPLIED. Objective's signed coefficients are dual weights, NOT signed physical amplitudes. Native P000 X6 Cell/time mapping, independent Driver review, formal checking and native TASK result are pending.

Next: classify off-diagonal points outside both currently proved separating rectangles. Distinguish linear hull equality from nonconvex behavioral-image equality.
